title: Microsoft Comic Chat is now open source
summary: Microsoft has open sourced Comic Chat, a classic IRC client originally released in 1996 that displayed conversations in comic strip format with animated characters representing different users. The project represents a unique piece of computing history that combined chat functionality with innovative visual storytelling UI design.
problem_solved: Makes a piece of computing history and innovative chat UI design accessible to developers and enthusiasts for learning and preservation.
why_valuable: Preserves an influential piece of software history while providing developers a reference for creative UI implementations in messaging applications.
